name: Magomusume Kinbaku Kankin Rape -Zecchou Acme Jigoku-
original_name: 孫娘緊縛監禁レイプ -絶頂アクメ地獄-
source: Yujiro goes with his daughter Kanae to visit his wife's father who lives in the country. His daughter hasn't seen her grandfather since she was very little. That night Yujiro wakes up tied to a chair and is forced to watch as his father in law rapes his granddaughter all night long.
translation: 佐藤裕次郎带女儿かなえ前往乡下，探望妻子的父亲。かなえ自幼年以后便再未见过外祖父。当天夜里，裕次郎醒来时发现自己被绑在椅子上，只能被迫看着岳父整夜强暴外孙女。
